vectors.desc: interior-slot alias, middle struct field: the *int64 field carries a path-ref into the S record's B slot; bytes of the aliased and an independent twin graph differ, each canonical
deriv: DECL tree: *main.W(id0)/main.W(id2) ARG2; V *main.S(id5)/main.S(id7) ARG3 A(9) int64(10,11) B(12) C(13); P *int64(15,16); B0 opens the W record(id17)
V: B0 opens the S record(id18) at grain equality, tag elided; A=INT 22, B=INT 24, C=INT 26 (zigzag 1/2/3)

P: REF18 (cc12) + marker 05 + field step 00/ARG 12 (the B name intern record, WF-18 name-addressed) + terminator 06 - the 0.2 path form (7.2); the edge is one token chain, the independent twin graph encodes a standalone cell record instead - distinct bytes, each canonical

vectors.desc: interior-slot alias over a slice element field: an element step into the backing record then a field step - mixed path, two step kinds, one path
deriv: DECL tree: *main.U(0)/main.U(2) ARG2; V []main.E(5,6) elem main.E(7,8) ARG1 F(9) int64(10,11); P *int64(13,14); B0 opens the U record(id15)
V: the slice opens its backing ARRAY record(id16) L=3 E=3, three value structs B0/INT (elements are not pointer targets), then VIEW form 0 {id} - the full window (WF-14, WF-15)

P: REF16 (cc10) + marker 05 + element step 01/ARG 2 (backing index space) + field step 00/ARG 9 (F) + terminator 06 - element steps root at the BACKING record, then the field step descends the element's inline storage (7.2 rooting)

vectors.desc: double reference: a standalone cell record whose body is a path-ref (p holds the interior alias, q points at p) - the cell opens by the path token, q closes by a bare REF to the cell
deriv: DECL tree: *main.R(0)/main.R(2) ARG3; A int64(5,6); P *int64(8,9) target REF5; Q **int64(11,12) target REF8; B0 opens the R record(id13)
P: the cell record(id14) opens with a path-ref body - REF13 (cc0d) + 05 + field step 00/04 (A) + 06: registration before children holds, one cell per reserved id (7.2 double reference)
Q: bare REF14 (cc0e) - an identity edge to the cell; handles bind slot storage at record open, values fill later, each slot read once at its own token (7.2 decode invariant)

vectors.desc: elision boundary: a position derivable by the 7.1 descent (leading field A) encodes as the bare REF with zero path bytes - the 0.1 form, byte-identical stream shape
deriv: same DECL tree as the alias vector; P targets the leading field A - derivable by the 7.1 descent (leading fields, zero-size skipped)

P: bare REF18 (cc12), no marker, no steps - mandatory elision (7.2): the common case stays byte-identical to a 0.1 stream; a stream spelling this descent as a path is the non-canonical reject of the negative set

vectors.desc: a path-free stream of a 0.2 encoder: header minor 02 over a self-ring body; the body is byte-identical to the 0.1 encoding of the same value - only the header minor byte differs
deriv: the 0.2 encoder emits header minor 02 on every stream, path-free streams included (4.4); the body carries no path form and no 0.2-only byte

the 0.1 twin of this value is the same stream with header minor 01 - the only differing byte is the header minor; a 0.1 decoder parses this header normally and decodes the body without meeting any unknown token

vectors.desc: a minor-01 stream carries the path form: the marker 05 is an unknown NIL-class selector in a known position - a loud format error at the token, the ext-selector discipline; a 0.2 encoder never produces this stream
zero-step path: the marker directly before the terminator - path is step+, one or more; the empty path is an error, not a synonym of the bare REF
a path whose steps exactly spell the derivable descent (leading field A): non-canonical - the derivable form is the bare REF with zero path bytes, and this spelling is an error, not a synonym

wrong rooting: an element step names the U struct record, not its slice's backing record - a struct descriptor declares fields, not elements; element steps root at the backing record, indices live in the backing's declared index space

zero-size terminal: the path names the Z field of the U record - Z is a member of the descriptor table and stays nameable as an interior step, but the terminal slot has zero-size declared type: identity of zero-size targets is neither preserved nor observable, the terminal rejects; the tracked non-zero grain of the same address keeps the record, the zero-size alias carries the marker (the adjacency holds)

out-of-family grain: the position's static target is *string, the terminal slot's declared type is int64 - the position grain is not pointer-to-the-declared-slot-type; out-of-family grains never resolve position-dependently
coder-backed step: the path names field C, whose type is a kind-14 CODER descriptor - no descriptor field table, layout delegated to the coder; the step rejects

index beyond the backing's declared length: element index 3 against L=3 - the index < L check runs before any pointer arithmetic (an argument can carry values near 2^63); the boundary witness L-1 = 2 is the positive carrier's own step; zero-tail indices [E, L) are legal and pre-charged - none exist here, E = L = 3

interface grain over an incompatible terminal: the interface-position path names the B field, whose declared type int64 is not interface-compatible - a path-ref at interface grain is legal only for an interface-compatible terminal slot; the collision mate: an opening at this position always carries the discriminating DESC, the path-ref carries none - the shapes stay byte-disjoint

interface-grain path over an interface-compatible terminal: the interface position holds a path-ref into the T record's Q slot, declared *int64 - a pointer slot serves an interface position; no value body follows the path-ref, so the byte shape stays disjoint from every opening at the same position (the collision matrix, positive side)
deriv: DECL tree: *main.U(0)/main.U(2) ARG2; V *main.T(5)/main.T(7) ARG2 F(9) int64(10,11) Q(12) *int64(13,14); I interface{}(15,16); B0 opens the U record(id17)
V: B0 opens the T record(id18) at grain equality; F=INT 22; Q=nil pointer selector 0 (WF-12)

I: REF18 (cc13) + 05 + field step 00/ARG 12 (Q) + 06 - the terminal slot is declared *int64, a pointer slot: interface-compatible; the handle materializes into the record's Q slot storage, tagless - no grain tag and no body byte ride the path-ref

vectors.desc: byte-charge boundary: under a lowered MaxBytes the chained element steps of a deep path push the value past the cap at a step byte - the path pays for itself; the validation walk is linear in path bytes, charges every step byte, and never allocates before the index check
